title: Vent Survey Fragment
obscured_text: The inscription tastes of iron, heat, and crushed shell.
A black chimney rises in the memory, then disappears under silt.
revealed_text: The crew traced a kinship between vent iron, Chalybeate sclerites, and hematic craft. They were careful enough to call the snails neighbors, not stock.
Their final note asks whether the sea itself can carry blood-memory without ever becoming blood.
